subject: Procurement kickoff: checklist & mutual deliverables
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@acmepartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement kickoff: checklist & mutual deliverables

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for taking the time to partner with Redwood Inference. To get the vendor setup and PO path moving quickly, please find a short mutual checklist below. I attached the Redwood vendor intake form and a draft MSA for your legal team to review.

What we need from Acme Partners (items to return to us):
- Completed vendor intake form (attached: redwood-vendor-form.pdf)
- Tax form: W-9 or local equivalent (PDF)
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, account number, routing; a voided check is fine)
- Certificate of insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured
- Legal entity name and billing address exactly as it should appear on POs/invoices
- Primary PO/purchasing contact (name + email + phone)
- Indication of preferred payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60)
- Any reseller or subcontractor declarations if applicable
- SOC 2 Type II report or timeline to provide it (if you have one)

What Redwood will provide / next steps on our side:
- Completed MSA (attached: MSA-draft-Redwood.pdf) and SOW template for signature
- Vendor portal invite and onboarding contact (I will send the portal link once we have your intake form)
- Point of contact for billing & procurement: Marissa Cole (cc'd)
- Expected timeline: vendor form + W-9 + COI returned = PO within ~5 business days (subject to credit/terms)

Would you be available for a 30-minute kickoff to walk through the form and confirm PO terms? I can do:
- Monday 4/26 10:00–10:30 PT
- Monday 4/26 14:00–14:30 PT

If those don't work, send two times that do.

Attachments: redwood-vendor-form.pdf (vendor intake), MSA-draft-Redwood.pdf (draft)

Best,
Priyom Das
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
priym.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@acmepartners.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acmepartners.com
Date: 2027-04-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: checklist & mutual deliverables

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear list. I've attached our vendor packet and our COI. A few quick notes:

- Attached: acme-vendor-packet.pdf (completed basic fields), acme-COI.pdf
- Our finance team prefers Net 30; please confirm Redwood's standard terms and your preferred invoice remittance address
- We will fill out the vendor intake form by EOD Monday; our legal will review the MSA draft and flag anything material
- For SOC 2: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II report but it won't be available until the week of May 10th; can you confirm whether a cert-of-review is sufficient in the interim?

We can do the 14:00 PT slot on Monday 4/26. I'll invite our contracts lead too.

Best,
Sophie Lang
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Partners
sophie.lang@acmepartners.com

Great — thanks Sophie, and welcome aboard. Confirming the 14:00 PT kickoff on Monday 4/26; please send the calendar invite to all participants when convenient.

I've attached Redwood's current W-9 for your records (Redwood-W9-2027.pdf) and set up a temporary vendor portal link so you can upload documents directly: https://vendor.redwood.com/setup/ACME-231.

Next steps (short):
1) You upload the completed vendor intake and COI to the portal (link above)
2) We confirm billing entity + banking details and finalize PO terms (Marissa will own this)
3) Once we have the intake + W-9 + COI, Procurement internally targets issuing a PO within ~5 business days

If SOC 2 won't be available until May 10th, that's fine for now — please ensure you upload any interim security attestations or a timeline in the portal and we'll loop in our security team.

Attachments: Redwood-W9-2027.pdf (tax form)

Thanks again — I'll follow up after the kickoff with a mutual action plan.

Best,
